name: Dungeon Matcher Stage09 compact wooden barrel
description: One compact battered wooden barrel environmental prop for a flat side-view pixel-art dungeon. Small stout cylinder roughly 26 native pixels wide and 34 pixels tall, centered with generous transparent margin on the 64x64 canvas. Front-facing elevation with only a thin shallow top ellipse, NOT an overhead view. Warm desaturated brown vertical staves, two cool dull-iron hoops, sparse edge wear and no decorative markings. Broader connected top-left light plane, right side shadow, clearly separated materials, one-pixel deep contour. Bottom sits flat with clean contact, no floating pieces, no ground plane or shadow blob. Whimsical chunky game object, low detail, hard clean native pixels, no texture noise, no glints, no anti-aliasing. Reference image is rendering discipline only, no skull, crown or character features.

style_image.usage_description: Use only native pixel crispness, economical connected planes and contour discipline. Preserve a small wooden barrel identity with brown wood and dull cool iron.
